thesis.core: Bank of Communications is a large, systemically important national bank with stable funding and improved H1 net interest margin. 2026H1 earnings are predominantly recurring and capital remains above regulatory requirements. But the A-share October rally is not evidence of an earnings breakout; retail asset-quality deterioration and lower annualized ROE limit the appropriate P/B multiple and prospective price-only return.
thesis.variant_wedge: H1 2026 revenue rose 6.73% and attributable profit 4.04%, NIM improved to 1.23% from 1.21%; however annualized weighted ROE fell to 8.09% from 9.16%, individual-loan NPL increased to 2.02% from 1.58% at 2025 year-end, credit-card NPL to 3.80% from 2.68%, and CET1 declined 18bp to 11.25%. H1 diluted EPS declined to RMB0.52 from RMB0.59 largely in a changed share-capital context; do not equate profit growth with per-share value growth.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: 2026H1 reported attributable RMB47.874bn, deducted attributable RMB47.600bn, and common EPS RMB0.52. Annualized common EPS approximately RMB1.04 (sensitivity RMB1.00-1.08) and common BVPS RMB13.22 are the normalized anchors. At 2026-10-28 price RMB8.26, P/B 0.625 and PE about 7.9x annualized EPS. 2026H1 proposed RMB0.168/share dividend, if repeated in H2, implies approximately 4.1% annualized indicative yield, not a guaranteed total-return component.

operating_and_financial_quality.judgment: Bank balance-sheet size and regulatory capital are adequate; NIM stabilization is positive. Retail NPL migration is the key negative: individual-loan NPL rose 44bp and credit-card NPL 112bp versus year-end. Provision coverage declined 4.58pp and CET1 declined 18bp. Bank CFO is driven by deposits/loans and should not be valued as industrial owner free cash flow. For a bank with roughly 8% ROE and retail credit pressure, a probability-weighted P/B near 0.678x is more appropriate than assuming peer multiples for stronger ROE/capital banks.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: H1 2026 reported attributable earnings RMB47.874bn are largely recurring (deducted RMB47.600bn). EPS annualization is a sensitivity, not a forecast; 2025 A-share issuance changes the per-share denominator. PB rather than mechanical PE is primary because ROE, common equity, credit costs, and capital adequacy determine bank equity economics. H1 2026 common BVPS RMB13.22 excludes preferred/other equity instruments. P/B multiples and probabilities are analyst assumptions; no speculative 2026Q3 numbers included.

catalysts: 2026Q3 report expected 2026-10-31 confirms stable NIM and recurring earnings, without further retail credit migration.
Lower deposit costs continue to offset loan repricing and support net interest margin above 2025H1 1.21%.
Retail NPL formation stabilizes and provision coverage remains near or above 200%, preserving capital and payout capacity.
CET1 stabilizes above the H1 2026 11.25% level while sustainable ordinary-share dividends are approved and implemented.
kill_thesis: Retail credit deterioration continues: personal NPL rate rises materially above H1 2.02% or credit-card NPL above H1 3.80%, with higher loss formation and credit costs.
Group NPL ratio rises materially above 1.30% while provision coverage falls materially below H1 203.80%, impairing normalized ROE.
Net interest margin falls materially below H1 1.23% without fee, deposit-cost or cost-control offsets.
Core Tier-1 capital continues to decline from 11.25% or a new dilutive capital raise weakens ordinary-share returns.
Ordinary-share cash payout becomes unsustainable or materially below the 2026H1 proposed 31% payout.

evidence_gap.near_term_update: 2026Q3 report scheduled for 2026-10-31; not available as of 2026-10-29 morning; material credit/capital/earnings changes require fresh D2.
